proposed_written_variety: Southern Quechua, Chanka/Ayacucho-oriented, three-vowel convention; not verified

coverage.english: Triadic Brain is examined as an architecture for attributable, bounded and revisable inquiry.
coverage.ai_draft: Triadic Brainqa maskay tapukuykunapaq huk ⟦architecture⟧ nisqa hinam qawarisqa kachkan: maymanta, pimanta hamusqanta riqsiy atinapaq, saywachasqa kanapaq, hinaspa yapamanta qawaspa allichay atinapaq.

coverage.english: What happens to a small piece of data when it enters Triadic Brain, and what additional warrant exists when the system later presents a useful result?
coverage.ai_draft: Huk huchuy willakuy Triadic Brainman yaykuptin, imataq pasan; hinaspa llika qipaman allin lluqsisqata rikuchiptin, ima yapasqa ⟦warrant⟧ nisqataq kan?

coverage.english: Answering requires separating three questions: what representation was transformed, what procedure actually consumed it, and what inference the resulting evidence supports.
coverage.ai_draft: Kutichinapaqqa kimsa tapukuykunata rakina: ima ⟦representation⟧ nisqataq tikrasqa karqa, ima ⟦procedure⟧ nisqataq chiqapta chayta llamkachirqa, hinaspa lluqsimuq ⟦evidence⟧ nisqaqa ima ⟦inference⟧ nisqatataq yanapan.
coverage.uncertainty_note: UNRESOLVED: Consumed describes actual processing or use of the representation, not destruction.

coverage.english: A source digest can establish an identity relationship without establishing factual truth.
coverage.ai_draft: Huk ⟦source digest⟧ nisqaqa ⟦identity relationship⟧ nisqata takyachiyta atin, ichaqa manam chaywan willakusqan chiqap kasqanta takyachinchu.

coverage.english: A schema-valid analogy can preserve a relation without validating transfer to a new domain.
coverage.ai_draft: Huk ⟦schema-valid analogy⟧ nisqaqa tinkuyta waqaychayta atin, ichaqa manam chaywan musuq ⟦domain⟧ nisqaman apay allin kasqanta chiqapchanchu.
coverage.uncertainty_note: UNRESOLVED: The relation preserved by the analogy need not be a meeting or connection; tinkuy is not a validated technical equivalent.

coverage.english: A reviewed candidate can still lack permission for a consequential use.
coverage.ai_draft: Qawasqaña ⟦candidate⟧ nisqapas hatun tikraykunata apamuq llamkachinapaq mana saqillayniyuq kanmanraq.
coverage.uncertainty_note: UNRESOLVED: Permission and consequential use require specialist and fluent review; wording about large changes may narrow the source meaning, and saqillayniyuq is unverified. Review does not itself authorize consequential use; consequential does not mean only harmful.

coverage.english: No product module was imported, no project test or CI job was run, no provider was called, and no installed client or live peer was exercised for this study.
coverage.ai_draft: Kay yachay maskaypaq manam ima ⟦product module⟧ nisqapas yaykuchisqachu karqa; manam proyectopa ima pruebanpas nitaq ⟦CI job⟧ nisqapas purichisqachu karqa; manam ima ⟦provider⟧ nisqapas waqyasqachu karqa; manataq churakusqa ⟦client⟧ nisqapas nitaq llamkachkaq ⟦peer⟧ nisqapas pruebasqachu karqa.

untranslated_scope: All source passages not explicitly listed; all tables, equations, appendices, references and separate companions; bracketed technical terms inside draft passages.
